CalibrationController

class CalibrationController(view, service=None)[source]

Bases: QObject

Controller of the calibration window.

Lists cameras, screens and aspect ratios, previews the camera, opens the automatic and manual calibrations and saves the hardware data (Calibration) of the chosen camera and screen.

Parameters:
viewCalibrationView

The calibration dialog.

serviceCalibrationService | None, optional

Calibration service. Default is None, which creates a new CalibrationService.

Attributes:
viewCalibrationView

The calibration dialog.

serviceCalibrationService

Calibration service.

threadCameraVideoThread | None

thread(self, /) -> PySide6.QtCore.QThread

Notes

The combo boxes are filled and the saved camera, screen and proportion are selected when the controller is created. User messages and button texts are translated with self.tr().

handle_ok()[source]

Save the hardware data and close the dialog.

Notes

The data from get_data is saved through create_calibration_hardware. On success, an information message is shown, the dialog is accepted and the camera preview is stopped; otherwise an error message is shown.

handle_cancel()[source]

Stop the camera preview and reject the dialog.

handle_calibrate_auto()[source]

Open the automatic calibration dialog.

handle_calibrate_semi()[source]

Show that semiautomatic calibration is not ready.

handle_calibrate_manual()[source]

Open the manual calibration dialog.

list_cameras()[source]

Fill the camera combo box, with the index as data.

list_monitors()[source]

Fill the screen combo box (name, with the index as data).

The name is "<manufacturer> - <model>", or "Monitor <n> (<name>)" when both are empty.

list_proportions()[source]

Fill the proportion combo box with the supported ratios.

control_camera()[source]

Start or stop the camera preview (F5 button).

Notes

While the preview runs, the camera, screen and proportion combo boxes are disabled. The CameraVideoThread is created with use_low_resolution set to is_raspberry_pi(), so the configured resolution is applied only on a Raspberry Pi.

stop_camera_stream()[source]

Stop the preview and reset the camera button and image.

Stop the preview and show a camera error.

Slot of CameraVideoThread.error_signal.

Parameters:
messagestr

Translated error message.

update_image(qt_img)[source]

Show a camera frame, scaled to the video label.

Slot of CameraVideoThread.change_pixmap_signal.

Parameters:
qt_imgQImage

Frame to show; the aspect ratio is kept.

get_data()[source]

Build the hardware calibration data from the selection.

Returns:
dict[str, Any]

Values for every Calibration field.

Notes

The camera resolution and frame rates come from the first video format of the camera (0 if it has none). The content area is the largest area of the chosen proportion that fits the available screen area (CalibrationMath.calculate_projection_area). The date uses AppConfig.get_geral_date_mask() and the time %H:%M:%S.
